name: Windows CI – TennisDesktopApp

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
	
		- name: Enable Visual C++ Developer Prompt
        uses: ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd@v1
        with:
          arch: ${{ matrix.arch }}       # select architecture :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

      - name: Install CMake & Ninja
        uses: lukka/get-cmake@latest
        with:
          ninja: true                     # installs Ninja :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: cmake -S . -B build -G "Ninja" -A x64 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --config Release
